mappings.name: AI policy
mappings.rationale: BRACE checks one deployment; it does not write an organization's AI policy.

mappings.name: Alignment with other organizational policies
mappings.rationale: BRACE does not compare policies across the organization.

mappings.name: Review of the AI policy
mappings.rationale: BRACE reviews releases, not the organization's policy documents.

mappings.name: AI roles and responsibilities
mappings.rationale: Every action names an accountable party and an operational owner, and every control has a named owner.

mappings.name: Reporting of concerns
mappings.rationale: BRACE has no channel for staff to raise concerns about AI.

mappings.name: Resource documentation
mappings.rationale: The release manifest and tool inventory list the parts that make up the agent and who owns each one.

mappings.name: Data resources
mappings.rationale: The manifest records dataset and retrieval settings, and the agent's reachable data stores are listed and tested.

mappings.name: Tooling resources
mappings.rationale: Every tool the agent can call is listed, justified, vetted, and pinned; tools used to build models are covered only by version records.

mappings.name: System and computing resources
mappings.rationale: Compute budgets, runtime limits, and reachable systems are set and tested for the deployed agent.

mappings.name: Human resources
mappings.rationale: BRACE does not assess staff skills or staffing.

mappings.section: A.5 Assessing impacts of AI systems
mappings.name: AI system impact assessment process
mappings.rationale: Each release rates its potential harm and autonomy, but only for security damage, not wider impact.

mappings.section: A.5 Assessing impacts of AI systems
mappings.name: Documentation of AI system impact assessments
mappings.rationale: The rating, its reason, and its approver are recorded with the release.

mappings.section: A.5 Assessing impacts of AI systems
mappings.name: Assessing AI system impact on individuals or groups of individuals
mappings.rationale: BRACE does not assess fairness, rights, or other effects on people.

mappings.section: A.5 Assessing impacts of AI systems
mappings.name: Assessing societal impacts of AI systems
mappings.rationale: BRACE does not assess effects on society.

mappings.name: Objectives for responsible development of AI systems
mappings.rationale: BRACE does not set development objectives for the organization.

mappings.name: Processes for responsible design and development
mappings.rationale: Harness, prompt, and config changes go through review, a recorded author, and release testing.

mappings.name: AI system requirements and specification
mappings.rationale: The deployment record and tool allowlist state what the agent may do; functional requirements are outside BRACE.

mappings.name: Documentation of AI system design and development
mappings.rationale: Versioned manifests and reviewed diffs record how each release was built and changed.

mappings.name: AI system verification and validation
mappings.rationale: Release candidates are tested against allowed tasks and attacks; accuracy and fitness testing are outside BRACE.

mappings.name: AI system deployment
mappings.rationale: Only a signed, approved setup that matches its manifest may run, with a tested rollback.

mappings.name: AI system operation and monitoring
mappings.rationale: Security monitoring, drift checks, and a tested kill switch cover the running agent.

mappings.name: AI system technical documentation
mappings.rationale: The manifest, identity hash inputs, and test evidence describe the agent; user-facing documentation is outside BRACE.

mappings.name: AI system recording of event logs
mappings.rationale: Every action is logged with six identity fields, kept across services, and protected from the agent.

mappings.name: Data for development and enhancement of AI systems
mappings.rationale: Training runs your team performs are linked to dataset versions and test results; data selection is outside BRACE.

mappings.name: Acquisition of data
mappings.rationale: Only approved sources may add retrieval content, and outside datasets are vetted before use.

mappings.name: Quality of data for AI systems
mappings.rationale: BRACE checks data integrity and trust, not whether data is fit to train or evaluate a model.

mappings.name: Data provenance
mappings.rationale: Retrieval chunks and memory entries keep their source and writer; training data provenance is limited to version records.

mappings.name: Data preparation
mappings.rationale: BRACE does not cover cleaning, labeling, or transforming data.

mappings.name: System documentation and information for users
mappings.rationale: BRACE produces records for operators and reviewers, not for users.

mappings.name: External reporting
mappings.rationale: The incident drill names who decides whether to report outside the organization.

mappings.name: Communication of incidents
mappings.rationale: Alerts reach named responders, and the fleet drill tests who is told; outside communication is not tested.

mappings.name: Information for interested parties
mappings.rationale: BRACE does not decide what to tell people outside the deployment team.

mappings.name: Processes for responsible use of AI systems
mappings.rationale: High-impact actions need specific approval. Deployment decisions belong to accountable people; high-risk BRACE reports provide findings to inform a gradual monitored rollout.

mappings.name: Objectives for responsible use of AI systems
mappings.rationale: BRACE does not set the organization's goals for using AI.

mappings.name: Intended use of the AI system
mappings.rationale: The intended task is written down, and tools and credentials are limited to it and tested.

mappings.name: Allocating responsibilities
mappings.rationale: Each control names an owner on the agent team and an owner at the platform or vendor; contracts are outside BRACE.

mappings.name: Suppliers
mappings.rationale: Tools, servers, and models from suppliers are vetted, pinned, and re-checked when they change.

mappings.name: Customers
mappings.rationale: BRACE isolates tenants' data but does not cover what customers are told or promised.
